label: Growth experimentation and product strategy ownership
learning_outcome: Own product strategy for a growth area: identify opportunities, run a portfolio of experiments, and ship and iterate solutions that move retention and DAU metrics.
rationale: Growth-titled postings at Duolingo and Figma assign product strategy, experiment portfolios and retention metric ownership to a single role.
uncertainty: Only a few admitted postings carry the product-growth title, so the depth of statistical tooling and experimentation infrastructure expected is not established by the sample.
evidence_rationale: The only recorded product-growth claim: employer demand for owning a growth team's product strategy and experimentation from opportunity identification through shipping and iterating.

label: Paid acquisition and performance marketing operations
learning_outcome: Plan, run and optimize paid acquisition across mobile and emerging channels, managing LTV/CAC, CPI and creative strategy against revenue targets.
rationale: Performance marketing postings assign channel-level ownership of paid acquisition and pair it with unit-economics metrics and creative strategy.
uncertainty: Named channels (UAC, Meta, TikTok, YouTube, ChatGPT, Reddit) shift quickly, so sampled channel tactics may not transfer to a different channel mix.
evidence_rationale: Records demand for owning paid acquisition across mobile and emerging channels, matching this performance-marketing operations priority.

label: Lifecycle and retention marketing
learning_outcome: Design lifecycle journeys and campaigns for product areas using customer segmentation, A/B testing and SQL-based analysis.
rationale: Robinhood's lifecycle posting assigns journey strategy ownership and expects segmentation, testing and SQL as day-to-day tooling.
uncertainty: Segmentation and SQL expectations come from one lifecycle posting; other admitted postings do not restate them, so required analytics depth is unclear.
evidence_rationale: Records lifecycle journey and campaign ownership for product areas, the core retention-marketing work this priority covers.

label: Full-cycle enterprise selling
learning_outcome: Carry a full sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through multi-stakeholder negotiation and close on a named account list.
rationale: Full-cycle ownership, quota attainment and C-level negotiation recur across the admitted sales postings.
uncertainty: Advertised requirements describe posted role scoping, and the admitted set does not show which of these skills hiring teams actually screen for.
evidence_rationale: Both sales-account-executive claims describe owning the full cycle from prospecting and qualifying through negotiating and closing, directly supporting this priority.

label: Expansion and renewal revenue
learning_outcome: Grow existing accounts through discovery, activation and upsell while managing renewals, pricing negotiation and client retention.
rationale: Stripe grower roles and Figma's mid-market posting define growth as maintaining and expanding an existing book of business rather than net-new acquisition only.
uncertainty: Expansion-focused postings come from a small set of employers, so renewal mechanics may differ by product and contract model.
evidence_rationale: Records demand for maintaining and growing an existing mid-market customer book, matching expansion and renewal revenue work.

label: Programmatic and ad-platform revenue selling
learning_outcome: Own a programmatic revenue target: build pipeline and forecast, negotiate annual and upfront commitments with agencies and trading desks, and optimize campaign performance.
rationale: Ad sales postings at Duolingo and Pinterest assign revenue target ownership, forecast accountability and agency-side negotiation.
uncertainty: Programmatic selling appears only in ad-monetization postings, so transferability to non-advertising growth roles is unverified.
evidence_rationale: Records ownership of a programmatic revenue target plus consultative solution-selling into retail media accounts, both ad-platform revenue motions.

label: Public sector procurement selling
learning_outcome: Sell into SLED and federal buyers using contract vehicles, channel partners and multi-stakeholder procurement processes.
rationale: Vanta's regional SLED postings and Figma's federal civilian posting require procurement-landscape fluency and government contract vehicles.
uncertainty: Government selling is confined to a niche group of postings; whether a growth role needs it depends entirely on the employer's customer segment.
evidence_rationale: Records SLED and federal procurement selling demand, exactly the public-sector motion this priority covers.

label: Run an end-to-end technical sales cycle
learning_outcome: Own every stage from prospecting through demonstration, negotiation, and close without handing off to a specialist.
rationale: This is the most repeated framing of the role in the admitted sample, appearing across Datadog, Twilio, Verkada, and MongoDB postings, and it subsumes several narrower skills listed elsewhere.
uncertainty: Excerpts give cycle expectations but rarely the deal size, segment, or product complexity that would set how much depth is needed.
evidence_rationale: Full-cycle ownership from prospecting to close (with demos and negotiation) plus the SaaS/PaaS full-cycle closing expectation are the recorded evidence that an AE must personally run the whole cycle.

label: Build and carry new-business quota coverage
learning_outcome: Generate net-new customer acquisition through outbound prospecting and manage performance against an assigned quota.
rationale: Quota and net-new business language recurs across the Verkada, Twilio, and Datadog postings, making prospecting volume and quota management the second most load-bearing skill set.
uncertainty: Quota mechanics differ by posting (iACV targets versus general net-new emphasis), and none of the excerpts state quota values or ramp expectations.
evidence_rationale: The net-new business quota demand is the only recorded claim evidencing acquisition targets and assigned quota ownership.

label: Manage pipeline and a named book of business
learning_outcome: Sustain a forecastable pipeline and independently manage a defined book of business or territory.
rationale: Pipeline development and book-of-business ownership appear in the GitLab, MongoDB, and Verkada postings, and are the operational substrate the full-cycle and quota skills above depend on.
uncertainty: The excerpts do not name the CRM or forecasting tooling; tool-specific terms in the data come from skill tags rather than prose, so required system fluency is inferred.
evidence_rationale: Book-of-business ownership running from pipeline development through close is the recorded demand for sustaining a forecastable pipeline and named territory.

label: Execute land-and-expand playbooks
learning_outcome: Grow existing accounts by closing new workloads and upselling beyond the initial purchase.
rationale: MongoDB growth postings, the Databricks emerging enterprise role, and the Datadog sponsorship role all pair expansion or renewal targets with new-business duties, indicating expansion is expected alongside acquisition.
uncertainty: Excerpts describe expansion expectations but not the expansion mechanisms, contract structures, or product attach patterns used to achieve them.
evidence_rationale: Closing new workloads while expanding existing accounts is the recorded land-and-expand demand behind this priority.

label: Sell consultatively to enterprise stakeholders
learning_outcome: Apply discovery and consultative selling to build durable customer relationships while meeting quota.
rationale: GitLab, Datadog, and Twilio postings describe consultative cycles for enterprise and complex deals, and O*NET lists post-sale client consultation as a documented task, so the skill is both advertised and occupationally grounded.
uncertainty: No excerpt details the discovery methodology or stakeholder mapping expectations beyond general consultative phrasing.
evidence_rationale: The documented consult-with-clients duty providing ongoing support grounds the durable-relationship element, though it covers post-sale support rather than pre-sale discovery.

label: Employment law and policy compliance
learning_outcome: Apply core employment-law and HR-policy principles to daily people operations and policy documentation.
rationale: Instacart asks for working employment-law knowledge, Coinbase for policy work aimed at compliance and risk reduction, and Justworks names employment legislation.
uncertainty: No posting specifies jurisdiction scope, required certifications or the depth of legal knowledge expected.
evidence_rationale: The only demand claim covering employment law and policy application in day-to-day people operations.

label: HR business partnering and org advisory
learning_outcome: Advise and coach managers and leaders on organization design, change management and workforce planning.
rationale: Stripe, Instacart and senior SpaceX postings describe advising leaders on organization design, change and people strategy.
uncertainty: Expected leader seniority (Director/VP+) is stated in only some postings, and the split between strategic and operational duties varies.
evidence_rationale: Postings describe advising and coaching leaders on org design, strategy and change management, matching this priority's advisory outcome.

label: HRIS administration and lifecycle transactions
learning_outcome: Maintain employee records and execute hire-to-exit transactions in an HRIS.
rationale: SpaceX postings name Workday transactions and HRIS upkeep across the employee lifecycle.
uncertainty: Specific systems and required proficiency levels are not stated beyond Workday mentions.
evidence_rationale: Together these cover HRIS transaction processing in Workday and the hire-to-exit lifecycle events (transfers, promotions, exits) the priority names.

label: Employment records and HR system upkeep
learning_outcome: Maintain accurate employment records for hiring, termination, leave, transfer and promotion events in HR management systems.
rationale: O*NET lists preparing employment records for lifecycle events in HR management system software among core HR Specialist tasks, matching the HRIS duties advertised in the sample.
uncertainty: O*NET task lists describe the occupation broadly and give no proficiency or system-specific detail.
search_terms: Interpret and explain human resources policies
evidence_rationale: The O*NET core task is the direct foundation for maintaining employment records for hiring, termination, leave, transfer and promotion events in HR systems.

label: Internal mobility and exit processes
learning_outcome: Run internal transfer, promotion and exit-interview processes for an assigned employee group.
rationale: SpaceX generalist and business-partner postings list internal transfers, promotion oversight and exit interviews among duties.
uncertainty: Whether the role owns these processes or supports them is not stated in the postings.
evidence_rationale: This posting evidence names internal transfers, promotion facilitation and exit interviews, the exact processes this priority covers.

label: Onboarding program coordination
learning_outcome: Coordinate new-hire onboarding and serve as the program point of contact.
rationale: SpaceX coordinator postings assign onboarding point-of-contact duties and list onboarding among employee life-cycle skills.
uncertainty: Evidence is limited to coordinator-level postings, and program scope (design versus delivery) is unspecified.
evidence_rationale: The posting duty of serving as onboarding point of contact for the new hire program is the recorded support for onboarding coordination.

label: HR process automation and redesign
learning_outcome: Map and redesign HR processes, introducing automation for manual steps.
rationale: Lyft's HR operations posting asks for end-to-end process evaluation, automation and low-code tooling.
uncertainty: Single posting; workflow-tooling and M&A specifics may not transfer to other employers.
evidence_rationale: This posting evidence covers evaluating end-to-end HR lifecycle processes to remove friction and add automation, matching the redesign outcome.
